description_en: Creates a reverse task for a specified synchronization or migration task by calling the CreateReverseDtsJob operation
description_zh: 调用CreateReverseDtsJob接口，为目标同步或迁移任务创建一个反向任务
name: CreateReverseDtsJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization or migration task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 同步或迁移任务的ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The account of the shard in a MongoDB sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh: MongoDB分片集群实例的Shard的账号
parameters.name: shard_username

parameters.help_en:
The password of the shard in a MongoDB sharded cluster instance.

This parameter is available and required only when the source database instance is a MongoDB sharded cluster instance.
This parameter takes effect only when ModifyAccount is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
MongoDB分片集群实例的Shard的密码。

当源数据库实例为MongoDB（分片集群架构）时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
当ModifyAccount取值为true时才生效
parameters.name: shard_password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. This is a global parameter that does not need to be specified for this operation
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入
parameters.name: resource_group_id

DtsInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the DTS instance that corresponds to the generated reverse task
DtsInstanceId.description_zh: 生成的反向任务对应实例的ID

DtsJobId.description_en: The ID of the generated reverse synchronization task
DtsJobId.description_zh: 生成的反向同步任务的ID

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
